title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) (2) Sennheiser 421 + (1) Beyer M160 ->  Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a high‑energy show with a smoking Loser and standout Crazy Fingers.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about the crystal‑clear, well‑wired audience capture that makes you feel right in the venue. The performance is described as “cooking” from start to finish, with the Loser delivering a killer solo and Phil’s bass run, plus a breakout Crazy Fingers. Overall the show is high‑octane and the recording quality is top‑tier for an audience source.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (3 out of 5) give 4–5 stars and praise both the music and the sound, outweighing a couple of low‑star, off‑topic comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Widely regarded as one of the best audience recordings; wired setup gave clear, vivid scene sound with minimal muddiness. No major mix issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high energy throughout the set; the band stayed tight and enthusiastic from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for a killer bass run and strong solo on Loser.
